title: TALES: A Taxonomy and Analysis of Cultural Representations in LLM-generated Stories

bias_targets.methodology: Human annotation of LLM-generated stories tailored to specific regional identities using a custom taxonomy (TALES-Tax) to identify cultural inaccuracies, clichés, oversimplifications, and factual errors, alongside the automated extraction and evaluation of Culturally Specific Items (CSIs).

Comparing the frequency and categories of misrepresentations (such as linguistic and logical errors) in stories generated across high-resource (English), mid-resource, and low-resource Indic languages.

Stratifying and comparing the rate of misrepresentations in generated stories set in Tier-1 (metropolitan), Tier-2 (urban), and Tier-3 (semi-urban/rural) regions in India to measure disparities in local representation.
